description: This file defines the Subscription model class for the Opencart admin report extension, including methods to retrieve subscription data and totals with filtering options.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class for handling subscription report data, including methods to get subscription details and total counts.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscriptions with filters, grouping, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscription records based on filters.
